unit.why: A single narrative: on a cloudy night R. Zvi Hirsh of Zidichov makes the moon visible through an unusual window so the ailing Seer of Lublin can sanctify it.

stories.start_quote: ידוע כי מרן הקדוש מלובלין זצוק"ל בשנה
stories.end_quote: להטריח יותר בחולשת כחינו לחלון הרחוק
stories.summary_en: In the Seer of Lublin's last year, the sky is clouded at the time for sanctifying the moon, and R. Zvi Hirsh of Zidichov is escorting his ailing master. When the Seer wishes aloud for a moon, R. Zvi brings him back and makes the moon shine at a window that never faces it. The Seer explains that R. Zvi rearranged the heavens, not the study-hall walls.

באותו הצד אשר משם לא נראית הלבנה מעולם
